title: refactor: use one event type for MCP calls
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Records all receipt-billed MCP operations as `mcp.call`
- Removes capability-specific event types from MCP registry entries
- Keeps server, provider, pricing adjustment, status, and billing attribution unchanged

Tests: `npm run test -- test/mcp-proxy.test.ts`; `npm run typecheck`

gist.headline: One buzz, one receipt
gist.blurb: MCP billing events have stopped collecting specialty labels like rare stamps. Every receipt-billed tool call now leaves the hive as one tidy `mcp.call` event.
gist.summary: Normalized all receipt-billed MCP operations to emit the single `mcp.call` generation event while preserving server, provider, pricing adjustment, status, and billing attribution metadata.
gist.impact: MCP billing and usage consumers now receive a consistent `mcp.call` event shape across tools without losing attribution or pricing details.
gist.visual_concept: Depict event normalization as Polli sorting several differently labeled MCP receipt slips into one clearly marked `mcp.call` mailbox, while a cozy terminal preserves the server, provider, pricing, status, and attribution stamps. A small code-plant and flowers make the internal plumbing feel like a well-tended garden.
